description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and the o_pop frequency (scaled by 10^4) for two metrics: Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy. The x-axis, labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)", spans from 1 to 19 with integer tick marks, representing a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with major gridlines at 0.2 intervals, also on a linear scale. The "Initial Accuracy" is represented by a green line with square markers and error bars; it starts at approximately 0.35, increases to a peak of about 0.5 at an o_pop frequency of 13, and then decreases to around 0.4 at an o_pop frequency of 19. The "Final Accuracy" is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers and error bars; it begins at approximately 0.65, fluctuates with a peak near 0.92 at an o_pop frequency of 9, and ends at about 0.88 at an o_pop frequency of 19.
